description: Limits the status-watcher agent's Bash use to a single foreground sleep, so a poller cannot run any other command.

hooks.command: tr -d '\n' | awk 'index($0, "\"agent_type\":\"outsystems:status-watcher\"") && !match($0, /"command":"sleep [1-9][0-9]*"/) { print "Denied: status-watcher may run no Bash command except exactly sleep <seconds>. Poll with your status tools, and use Bash only to wait between polls." > "/dev/stderr"; exit 2 }'
